action.description: Deterministic action. 'normalize_paths' and 'generate_detections' are planned (stages N4 and G1) and are rejected with a message naming them.

sources.description: File paths to adversary_path_projector exports: one path graph, one scenario seed, or both documents of the same projection run.

accept_unverified_pair.description: Join two documents that carry no provenance block, on equal derived projection identity. The join is recorded as asserted_by_operator and never as verified.
